items.title: No passing submission
items.finding: The primary and both sensitivity scenarios lose to nnPU overall and in the highest-propensity stratum.

items.title: Literal overlap rule is saturated
items.finding: A registered continuous prior is positive across the footprint; all nonempty candidates fail the inherited forward-overlap gate.
items.disposition: Verified witness; stopped before placement. Protocol change belongs to selector/owner.

items.title: EM did not converge
items.finding: Inner optimizers succeeded, but all fold/scenario EM fits reached the preregistered cap.
items.disposition: Finite-iteration results only; optimization gate blocked. Do not rerun/tune this consumed holdout.

items.title: No identified propensity scale
items.finding: No independently verified exhaustive mapping anchor exists; PU factorization alone does not identify e and f.
items.disposition: Three assumed reference-point propensities reported as sensitivities, not measured completeness.

items.title: No organizer-confirmed score
items.finding: The prompt’s reported best/leader targets differ; sibling projection/UNSCORED language conflicts with some owner-reported results.
items.disposition: No leaderboard value represented as ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED.

items.title: Registry scan stopped / incomplete
items.finding: Only three prior rasters compared before the mandated stop. Prediction-like path inventory is not all historical/private/release artifacts.
items.disposition: No all-prior uniqueness claim; no download.

items.title: Mirror provenance is not official authentication
items.finding: Hashes match the public owner bridge. Original official downloads and external-data terms were not directly verified.
items.disposition: Provenance labels and manual official source links supplied.

items.title: Range-error cause not attributable
items.finding: The rejected TIFF itself was not supplied. A negative sentinel, raw logits, or out-of-footprint values are possible causes, not a diagnosis.
items.disposition: New writer rejects invalid ranges and masks; generated research TIFF passes local validation.

items.title: Template optional-argument issue already known upstream
items.finding: gems57 evaluate_holdout uses dict.get(masked_known, fold[visible]), whose fallback is eagerly evaluated. This runner supplies visible in every fold, so the issue does not affect these results. The sibling gems61 implementation already has a lazy lookup fix.
items.disposition: Unmodified template retained; no private fork. Document upstream repair rather than claim to have fixed it locally.

items.title: Claimed previous-session state absent
items.finding: Initial repo contained only an 11-byte README; no pipeline or cache.
items.disposition: Built missing tools and restored usable mirrored data; CPU experiment completed.

items.title: Future-looking submission identifier
items.finding: The archived prompt includes a 20261012 identifier although this session is dated 2026-10-11 UTC.
items.disposition: Identifier is not treated as proof of generation/submission date.

items.title: No comparable incumbent receipt
items.finding: Older translated-truth/live-mirror numbers are not a same-fold benchmark.

items.title: GitHub administration permission limited
items.finding: Read of Actions repository-permission settings returned 403 Resource not accessible by integration.
items.disposition: This is a settings permission limitation, not proof Actions or Pages cannot run. Native Pages was already configured.

items.title: Metadata revision comparison repaired during review
items.finding: The tree-query revision in this API environment matched the commit ID, not the nested root-tree ID. The first local feed overcounted changes.
items.disposition: Compare the reviewed revision with both actual commit and root-tree IDs. Rebuilt feed before publication; records retain both identities.

items.title: Preregistration detail gap
items.finding: The mechanism/scenarios/gates were written before fitting, but the prose did not spell out every solver/sample setting. The numeric 25-iteration cap was fixed in execution code.
items.disposition: Executed settings and original source hashes recorded separately. Do not call the numerical configuration fully preregistered or the EM result converged.
